product_metadata.title: Vintaj TP0400-01 Jewelry Technique Book
features: 24 Beautifully photographed and meticulously detailed step-by-step techniques for working with filigree, focal, altered blanks, bezels and findings
description: Clear off your design space, prepare your tools and pull out your Vintaj findings. In the pages of this technique book you will learn how to combine Natural Brass, Arte Metal and Artisan Copper with Vinatj Patinas, image transfer, etching, embossing, distressing, riveting, hammering, melt art and many more techniques. Learn how to create your own bezel, wrap with filigree and create altered effects the possibilities are endless. Join us on this creative journey and see where it takes your designs.
